title: Fix Command Center hcom instance names
description: Replace invalid hyphenated hcom --name defaults in the AI Command Center wrapper and monitor with underscore-safe base names, update installed launchers, and verify operator commands no longer raise instance-name validation errors.
acceptance_criteria: The ai wrapper runs hcom control commands without an agent --name and ai status completes without an instance-name error.
The monitor queries hcom events without an agent --name and does not suppress an instance-name error.
Operator messages remain attributed through --from command-center, while repository templates and installed launchers match.
